independent_approval.approved_brief: Show a broad, raised service surface with a solid front, a small parcel resting on top, a staff side behind it, and clear customer standing space in front. Crop around the surface and front panel. Exclude a dominant register, refund receipt, or order handoff that would turn the image into a particular service function.
independent_approval.source_findings: The retained Kenney Furniture Kit 2.1 kitchenBar and Car Kit 3.1 sealed taped box match their acquired originals and both retained CC0 licenses. Complete source geometry, materials, textures and child transforms are preserved; four counter roots and one uniformly scaled parcel root form the scene. Neither source has animation clips.
visual_findings: The broad pale raised surface, solid paneled front and L return identify a generic customer service counter. The staff-side recess is visible; the unobstructed foreground leaves room for customers.
The small sealed parcel supports the current example without dominating the counter or indicating payment, refunds or order handoff. No register, text, logo or payment credentials appear.
Root inspected the original counter rear view, sealed parcel front view, final 512x293 image and both native-scale and enlarged contacts covering all four actual minimum WordCard states.

At the real 126x72 and144x74 card sizes, the front and L silhouette remain readable under the matched alpha/badge. The near-white top loses some edge contrast against white, but the complete service surface remains identifiable.
accepted_adaptations: Place and rotate complete counter model roots to form a broad three-section front and one return.
Uniformly scale and place one complete licensed sealed parcel model on the surface.
Use orthographic camera, restrained lighting, transparent rendering and content crop; preserve source geometry and materials.
independent_approval.production_delivery: Pending exact approved-byte copy and production media-loader/crop/cache verification; scratch WordCard assignment is not production delivery.

adaptations: Four complete acquired Furniture Kit 2.1 kitchenBar models form a broad raised surface with a solid front and a perpendicular staff-side return. Original geometry, materials, textures and source child transforms are preserved; only complete model roots are placed and rotated, then the common assembly is recentered.

One complete acquired Car Kit 3.1 box model supplies the small sealed parcel. Its original geometry, materials, texture and child transforms are preserved; the root is uniformly scaled to 0.16, rotated -10 degrees and placed at the countertop height of 0.42. No added register, refund receipt, printed label or service-function prop is used.

The orthographic camera is at [-1.1,1.8,4], aimed at [0,0.24,0], size 1.55. Ambient energy 0.18 and directional energy 0.38 illuminate a transparent 768 by 768 render. The complete alpha bounds remain within the frame; a 16-pixel margin and proportional Lanczos downscale produce 512 by 293.

Independent root review covers the exact broad-return image and actual Match 126 by 72 and Memory 144 by 74 cards, including the real badge and matched alpha. The pale top has reduced contour contrast on white and the badge overlaps the far-right return, while the solid front and staff-side recess remain readable. This scoped AI picture review is not a participant recognition study, service-function classification, domain approval or module-readiness claim.
